artDirection.centralObjects: Reuse one master per object family, including repeated instances in a composition. A sword, scimitar and scythe are different families; every appearance of each family uses its same master.
artDirection.edgeRule: Outer 20 percent of the crop falls to near-black, without a visible frame.
artDirection.material: Charcoal object faces with dim silver or colored rim; simple planes, no ornate engraving.
artDirection.effectRule: A narrow broken luminous contour releases soft fog from the object surface. Fog hugs and then diffuses away from the object, with a small occluded section behind it.
avoid: generic smoke cloud disconnected from the object
artDirection.colorPolicy: Main action supplies dark ground and subdued center tint; an explicit element may tint emitted contour fog. Additional conditions use shapes and keep lower brightness. Avoid four competing saturated colors.
artDirection.productionConsistency: Use the same asset/mesh ID for every occurrence. Image-generated proposal boards illustrate the rule but do not guarantee pixel-identical objects or constitute reusable transparent layer assets.

sword.description: Straight double-edged steel blade, tiny triangular notch at base, straight dark brass guard, black wrapped grip.
sword.viewPolicy: Pre-render from one master; do not redraw a new design per view.

scimitar.description: Single curved steel blade, black wrapped grip and simple brass guard; preserve curvature.
scimitar.viewPolicy: Pre-render from one master; do not redraw a new design per view.

scythe.description: Long black shaft with one short crescent steel blade; preserve blade-to-shaft ratio.
scythe.viewPolicy: Pre-render from one master; do not redraw a new design per view.

hammer.description: Rectangular charcoal iron head, narrow brass band, straight black handle.
hammer.viewPolicy: Pre-render from one master; do not redraw a new design per view.

shield.description: Plain charcoal kite shield, narrow silver border, circular brass boss; no crest.
shield.viewPolicy: Pre-render from one master; do not redraw a new design per view.

card.description: Blank charcoal rectangle, thin silver double outline, fixed corner radius and aspect ratio.
card.viewPolicy: Pre-render from one master; do not redraw a new design per view.

leaf.description: Single pointed olive-silver leaf, one central vein and short stem.
leaf.viewPolicy: Pre-render from one master; do not redraw a new design per view.

orb.description: Plain dark glass sphere, no changing interior symbol or ornament.
orb.viewPolicy: Pre-render from one master; do not redraw a new design per view.

vial.description: Small round dark glass flask, short silver neck and dark stopper.
vial.viewPolicy: Pre-render from one master; do not redraw a new design per view.

chain.description: Three thick dark iron links of identical cross-section.
chain.viewPolicy: Pre-render from one master; do not redraw a new design per view.

flame.description: Single simple upright flame silhouette, reused for fire-based condition symbols; Cleansed is ivory-white with a muted gold edge.
flame.viewPolicy: Reuse this contour; vary color and emitted fog only.

consumable.label: Consumable

naming.policy: Display-name suggestions only. Existing IDs and mechanics remain unchanged. References marked related-not-equivalent must not be used as automatic aliases.
additionalSuggestions: Use nouns for techniques: Piercing, Precision, Evasion, Area.
Use condition labels consistently: Burning, Bleeding, Chilled, Frozen, Paralyzed, Asleep, Prone, Confused, Restrained.
Use Dazed for the open spiral and Confused for opposed hooks.
Keep Frost (element), Chilled (condition) and Frozen (condition) visually distinct.
Use Reflect for reflection; Attunement for the proposed WIS buff.
Use Reshuffle hand only after deciding whether the hand is discarded/redrawn or mixed back into the draw pile.
Cleansed uses an ivory-gold purifying flame, per user correction. Cleanse is the action name.
